headline: Executive order directs the federal government to take a leading role in reducing texting while driving.
what_it_does: This executive order addresses texting while driving and has the federal government set an example. The title points to rules for the federal workforce, such as limits on federal employees texting while driving. No summary was provided, so the exact rules and who must follow them are not detailed here.

who_it_affects.how: They are likely the main group covered by new limits on texting while driving, especially when on government business or in government vehicles.
